gaps.sentence: Sales figures have tailed ___ since the summer.
He puts his success down ___ hard work and a bit of luck.
gaps.explanation: put something down TO something = believe it has that cause.

gaps.sentence: The match kicks ___ at three o'clock.
Don't leave ___ any details in your report.
The new law will phase ___ disposable plastics by 2030.
gaps.explanation: phase out = gradually stop using something.

gaps.sentence: Lawyers are drawing ___ the contract now.
gaps.explanation: draw up = prepare and write (a contract, list, plan).

gaps.sentence: They worked ___ a compromise after hours of discussion.
gaps.explanation: work out = find the solution to; understand; also exercise.

gaps.sentence: The protesters set ___ at dawn from the village square.
gaps.explanation: set off/out = begin a journey; set up = establish.
